meta.method: walk-portals.mjs national harvest police-crime: the 12 latest months, the box in 6 tiles (the API refuses polygons with over 10,000 crimes: 503); crimes deduplicated by id; positions are police.uk anonymised snap points (each the centre of a street or a public place, never an address); aggregated to snap point x category over the 12 months, and to month x category. No crime ids, outcomes or persistent ids kept
meta.sensitivity: aggregates only; categories as published (violence-and-sexual-offences is one category on police.uk and is kept only as a count)
